title: Replace Hybrid/EV Battery Pack
description: The Battery Management System (BMS) detected internal resistance imbalance or voltage degradation across cell modules.
possibleFixes: Perform battery module balancing or pack replacement

title: Battery Energy Control Module Fault
description: Internal micro-controller self-test failure within the High Voltage Battery Management System.
symptoms: Vehicle fails to enter READY state

title: Lost Communication with ECM/PCM
description: CAN gateway lost high-speed communication with the primary Engine/Powertrain Control Module.
possibleFixes: Check CAN bus termination resistor (120 Ohm)

title: Drive Motor Inverter Cooling Performance
description: Inverter coolant temperature exceeded target threshold during high load operation.
symptoms: Cooling fan running at maximum speed
possibleFixes: Check coolant fluid level in EV thermal loop
Bleed air from inverter cooling system

title: System Voltage Low (12V Auxiliary)
description: 12V auxiliary battery voltage dropped below 11.0 volts during active operation.

title: Drive Motor Inverter Performance
description: Phase current mismatch detected in high-voltage electric motor inverter circuit.

title: Engine / Drive System Failed to Start
description: HV interlock loop open or start authorization denied by drive control unit.
symptoms: Car will not switch to Drive mode
possibleFixes: Check HV service disconnect plug status
